description: MANDATE-07 #7b 'giai doan binh thuong' (normal period): the mandate's precision figure is only meaningful if the labeled set contains a stretch with NO injected fault — precision = correct fires / total fires, so a detector that alerts constantly must be punished for it. This case injects nothing at all and simply observes the running stack for 5 minutes under its ordinary load-generator traffic. Any alert raised in this window is a false positive and drags precision down. Kept separate from MANDATE-15's case_healthy_load.json, which deliberately drives ELEVATED load to prove 'busy is not broken'; this one is the plain baseline.
